newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Refining to cut costs, 65 staff.
newsitem.headline: NZ Refining to cut costs, 65 staff.

text.p: The New Zealand Refining Co on Friday announced plans to cut 65 staff.
The present level of 370 positions within the company will reduced to 305 by the end of 1998, it said in a statement, adding reductions would be phased, starting later this year.
The job cuts are one of a number of recommendations contained in a report produced by an internal study team set up to look at the preferred future organisation of the company.
Another major recommendation of the study involves the realignment of the company's contracting strategy for indirect labour.
This is expected to result in a 20 to 25 percent reduction in the costs of contracted work at its Marsden Point site over the next two years.
Overall, implementation of the recommendations is expected to result in a reduction of the company's operating costs of some NZ$10 million per annum.
"There will be no negative effects on oil production levels of company income," the company said.
